note: Consumed by `scripts/roster/generate.py --self-test`. Every case runs the same pipeline as a real run: routing.yaml text (fragment or file) + registry + snapshot rows -> mapping, effective chains, rules, gates, patch, in-memory apply and validation. `kind: validate` cases feed an attempted edit straight to the patch validator. Every `expect` is derived by hand from PLAN-M1-r5 §P1 rules, never from generator output. Snapshot rows are verbatim (slug, name, providerSlug) copies from the pinned evidence snapshot sha256 510dfcc8...2f2bad.
